name: Solrom
summary: Solrom Holdings Ltd is an Israeli company dedicated to the advancement and production of printhead laser technology for 3D printers. In addition to its research and development efforts, the firm also provides a selection of 3D printers to the market. Established in 2016, Solrom Holdings Ltd, with its headquarters located in Rosh Haayin, Israel, operated under the name 3DM Digital Manufacturing Ltd until its rebranding in September 2024.
